description: One SNOTEL station's snow season (Oct 1 to Sep 30): daily snow depth, snow water equivalent and the 30-year median SWE, weekly samples, the deepest day and peak SWE so far, first snow, melt-out, the same day last year, last season's peak, and the median onset, peak and melt-out dates. Give a station, or a place to use its nearest station.

latitude.description: Latitude, with longitude, instead of location.

location.description: A place ("Breckenridge, CO", "Mount Hood", "Alta, UT"), a US ZIP code, or "lat, lon".

station.description: A SNOTEL station name ("Berthoud Summit", "Berthoud Summit, CO"), id ("335") or triplet ("335:CO:SNTL"). Overrides location.

name: snow_depth_history
title: Snow depth season history
